## Introduction

In this assignment, I will be using the data I collected on movie ratings and implementing a Global Baseline Estimate recommendation system. The Global Baseline Estimate (GBE) recommendation system is a system designed to predict missing ratings. It is a non-personalized baseline model, that accounts for user and item biases. I'm anticipating challenges when dealing with missing ratings, and ensuring the bias estimates are stable, as the dataset is small.
